question: A solid wooden toy is in the shape of a right circular cone mounted on a hemisphere. If the radius of the hemisphere is 5.6 cm and the total height of the toy is 11.6 cm, then what is the volume of the wooden toy (in cm3 ) (rounded off to the closest integral value)?
solution:
[IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/ca81259519cadfb2d5350673c220e419e60378e9770ad26512fc8e826a8d93f1.png] __Shortcut Trick__

Using the combined volume formula for a cone on a hemisphere: V = (1/3) × π × r² × (2r + h)

Cone height h = Total height − radius = 11.6 − 5.6 = 6 cm.

V = (1/3) × (22/7) × 5.6 × 5.6 × (2 × 5.6 + 6)

V = (1/3) × 22 × 0.8 × 5.6 × 17.2 ≈ 565.07 cm³

Rounding off to the closest integer gives 565 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 565 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/c76c13ba2d2ab46b47f8a931ae621dac081a0cb266b142dc23f58659fac4a466.png] **__Alternate Method__**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/b450a9f57f3a9424c8d527d9eeff52a8b005ab2ac9e1b3a07457a94c7ebd2147.png] 

**Given:**

Total height of the toy = 11.6 cm

Radius of hemisphere (r) = 5.6 cm

**Formula Used:**

Volume of a Cone = (1/3) × π × r² × h

Volume of a Hemisphere = (2/3) × π × r³

Total Volume = (1/3) × π × r² × (2r + h)

**Calculations:**

⇒ Height of cone (h) = Total height − Radius of hemisphere

⇒ h = 11.6 − 5.6 = 6 cm

⇒ Total Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × (5.6)² × (2 × 5.6 + 6)

⇒ Total Volume = (1/3) × (22/7) × 31.36 × (11.2 + 6)

⇒ Total Volume = (1/3) × 22 × 4.48 × 17.2

⇒ Total Volume = (1/3) × 98.56 × 17.2

⇒ Total Volume = 1695.232 ÷ 3 ≈ 565.07 cm³

⇒ Rounding to the closest integral value, the volume is 565 cm³.

**∴ The correct answer is 565 cm³.**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **__Additional Information__**

Volume of a Hemisphere

V = (2/3) × π × r³, where r is the radius of the circular base.

Volume of a Right Circular Cone

V = (1/3) × π × r² × h, where r is the radius of the base and h is the height.

Surface Areas

Curved Surface Area (CSA) of a Cone = π × r × l, where slant height l = √(r² + h²). CSA of a Hemisphere = 2 × π × r².
